review_note: Ethereum Sepolia Blockscout stats has earned time-bounded Gate 1A eligibility for one explicit GET per approved alpha run. Eligibility expires on 2026-09-04 and returns to HOLD on host, schema, terms, rate-limit, deprecation, or network-identity drift.

units.quantity: Sepolia chain counters and gas statistics
units.notes: Fields use provider-defined units. gas_prices values are observational context only. coin_price and market_cap are not executable quotes and may not support production profitability claims.

sources.rate_limit_notes: Blockscout documents a default unauthenticated limit of 300 requests per minute. This Gate 1A profile permits one GET per explicit approved run and no automatic recurrence.
sources.concentration_risk_note: Single explorer instance and provider. Blockscout has announced future deprecation of per-instance endpoints in favor of its PRO API. Re-review by 2026-09-04 or immediately on host, schema, terms, rate-limit, deprecation, or network-identity drift.
